_comment: v3 agent loop. max_steps and the 5-minute budget are the starting limits from design section 3.5. max_invalid_outputs is one retry, then an automatic escalate. model is used when AGENT_MODEL is unset. A blank AGENT_MODEL is still an error. think is false so qwen3 does not fill a JSON call with hidden reasoning (OLLAMA_THINK overrides it). ollama_timeout_seconds is the per-call HTTP limit in seconds (OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_S). num_predict caps tokens generated for one JSON call (OLLAMA_NUM_PREDICT).
